paper_style.palette_strategy: 方法图以浅蓝/浅绿/浅橙模块色和红绿蓝 3D boxes 表达共享、geometry、language 与预测/GT角色；Figure 5 使用四条 categorical 方法曲线；表格保持黑白 booktabs、斜体分组和 bold best。颜色来自渲染估计，项目页仅提供 rendered PNG，不提供 palette constants。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: Figures 1–4、6–7 是 raster scene/thumbnail XObject 与 vector text、arrows、box/outline 的 mixed composition；Figure 5 在 p.10 没有 image XObject，为 vector plot；Tables 是 vector text/rules。
paper_style.style_consistency: caption、正文和表格稳定使用 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern；图内 asset 还混用 Calibri、SegoePrint、SegoeUISymbol、CambriaMath、Helvetica/DejaVuSans。浅蓝/绿/橙模块色跨 Figure 2/3/6 复用，red/green/blue boxes 大致复用但 Figure 4/6 缺少 key；字体和灰度可读性不完全一致。

caption.text: Figure 1: We propose Vid-LLM to achieve diverse 3D vision-language reasoning tasks using only video inputs.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝/紫框和蓝色 question card、桃色 answer card、红绿蓝 3D boxes 与自然图像共同编码任务卡、输出和空间框；文本位置与卡片形状提供冗余。

figures.data_and_statistics: 代表性室内场景的 qualitative example；没有样本量、分母、聚合或不确定性。中心重建和三张任务卡把摘要中的 video-only 输入与三种 3D VL 接口连起来。
figures.evidence_relation: 摘要“using only video inputs”的 headline → Figure 2/3 的共享视觉与训练机制 → Tables 1–5 的主结果以及 Figure 4/6 的定性任务证据。
design_strengths: 在一个代表性场景中同时展示 video、3D reconstruction 和三类 VL 输出，输入到任务的阅读顺序明确。
问答卡、空间 box 和 panel 位置对任务语义提供了冗余线索。
design_weaknesses: 中心 point cloud、filmstrip 和卡片文字在缩放后很小，信息密度高。
box 颜色没有 key，单个样例不能代表总体性能，灰度下红绿蓝语义不稳。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用一个代表性场景固定“输入媒介→中间结构→多个任务输出”顺序；任务卡统一 question/answer 结构，并补充框色语义。

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: Architecture of Vid-LLM. From video, a shared DINOv2 encoder produces tokens that are bidirectionally fused by Cross-Task Adapter with learnable Bridge Tokens, yielding geometric and semantic streams. The reconstruction branch predicts camera poses, depth and recovers real-scale via a Metric-Bins module, while the 3D-VL branch lifts features into 3D tokens for LLM reasoning.

color.semantic_mapping: 浅蓝表示视觉/共享 token 模块，浅绿表示 geometry/reconstruction，浅橙表示 language/VL，灰色为中性层；虚线边界和文字共同区分上下分支。

encodings.y: 3D-Reconstruction upper branch and 3D-VL Reasoning lower branch
encodings.color: blue/green/orange/gray boxes encode shared, geometry and language roles
encodings.shape: rounded module boxes, token squares, dashed branch boundaries
encodings.line: solid arrows for data flow and dashed outlines for branch boundaries
encodings.text: DINOv2, Bridge Tokens, Metric Bins, 3D patches, LLaVA and outputs

figures.data_and_statistics: 机制架构图，不包含观测样本、聚合统计或不确定性。它把 DINOv2、CTA、Global–Frame Attention、camera/depth heads、Metric Bins、3D patches 与 LLaVA 的模块接口放入同一数据流。
figures.evidence_relation: §3 CTA/metric-depth/3D-patch 机制 → Figure 2 的共享与分支接口 → Figure 3 的训练设计和 Tables 5–6 的 joint-task/ablation 结果。
design_strengths: 共享 encoder、CTA 和两个有边界分支同时呈现，模块责任和数据方向可追踪。
颜色、边界、箭头和直接标签共同表达几何—语义交互，并与公式 (1)–(4) 对齐。
design_weaknesses: 箭头、token 和 DPT/Metric Bins 细节在小尺寸下拥挤。
双向 attention 与正文所谓 one-way gradient flow 的差别没有完全用图形冗余表达。
figures.reusable_pattern: 将共享 encoder/adapter 放在中央，把 geometry 与 language 组织为平行分支，并把每个分支的输出绑定到可验证 artifact（pose/depth/point map 或 3D tokens/answer）。

figures.label: Figure 7

caption.text: Figure 7: Challenging Cases. We present one challenging case for each 3D VL task—3D question answering (a), 3D visual grounding (b), and 3D dense captioning (c). (a) Due to limited camera viewpoints in the input video, one chair is only partially observed and consequently missing from the reconstruction, leading to an undercounted result. (b) The highly reflective tabletop results in unstable depth estimates and incomplete reconstruction, resulting in a predicted 3D box that is smaller than the ground truth. (c) The top surface of the cabinet is not well reconstructed because it appears only briefly and mostly from oblique angles, yet Vid-LLM nonetheless produces an accurate caption by leveraging rich 2D semantic cues.

color.semantic_mapping: 红色表示预测框/错误 X，绿色表示 GT/check，蓝/桃卡片表示 Q/A；(b) 的文字 key 对 box 颜色提供冗余定义。

figures.data_and_statistics: 三个代表性 challenging cases：视角不足导致 chair 漏检、反光桌面导致 depth/box 不完整、斜视 cabinet 顶面重建差但 2D cues 仍支持准确 caption；没有 failure rate 或总体分母。
figures.evidence_relation: A.1 的 monocular-video failure boundary → Figure 7 的 coverage/surface/viewpoint cause → Figure 2 CTA 的 semantic bridge 解释 (c) 的 partial success。
design_strengths: 每行保持 input→reconstruction→answer 的阅读顺序，caption 把成因、重建缺陷和任务后果串成因果链。
(a)/(b) 的 GT 对照和 (c) 的成功边界同时展示 failure 与残余能力。
design_weaknesses: 每项任务只有一个案例，不能量化 failure 普遍性。
多帧、重建和长回答在缩放后偏小；红绿语义主要依赖颜色和局部文字。
figures.reusable_pattern: 把 failure 写成“输入覆盖/表面属性/视角→几何缺陷→任务后果”的案例矩阵，同时保留 GT 对照和仍成功的边界例。

caption.text: Table 1: Evaluation of 3D Question Answering on ScanQA and SQA3D. Methods marked with * are 3D MLLM evaluated in video mode. † indicates the model consumes VGGT-generated 3D geometry. “C” stands for “CIDEr”, “B-4” for “BLEU-4”, “M” for “METEOR”, “R” for “ROUGE”, and “EM@1” for top-1 exact match.

tables.uncertainty: No mean±SD/SE, interval, repeat count or uncertainty is displayed; “–” is a missing metric.

design_weaknesses: 21 rows force very small type; missing “–” has no semantic footnote.
Bold-only best marking and point estimates do not communicate stability or second-best separation.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 establishes the video-only 3D-VL interface; Figure 2/3 explain shared geometry–semantic architecture and two-stage training; Tables 1–5 quantify three VL tasks, joint quality and time; Table 6/Figure 5 isolate modules and convergence; Figures 4/6/7 provide success and failure-boundary cases; Tables 7–9 decompose reconstruction into pose, depth and point cloud.
cross_object_system.caption_system: 正文 Figure 1–5 captions use a short bold-style title followed by setup/mechanism or comparison; Figure 7 is the most self-contained failure caption, while Figure 6 is only “Qualitative Results.” Table captions use Evaluation/Comparison/Ablation titles, but abbreviation, missing-value and uncertainty definitions vary.
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Main and appendix result tables use dataset/task spanners over metric subcolumns with ↑/↓ directions. Table 5 adds reconstruction, three VL tasks and seconds/scene; Table 6 separates VL and reconstruction; Table 9 exposes GT cameras as an input-condition column.
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: CTA, Bridge Tokens, Metric Bins and two-stage training introduced in Figures 2/3 are recovered by Table 5 joint-task comparison, Table 6 component/token/MD rows and Figure 5 loss curves; Figures 4/6/7 connect grounding metrics to qualitative success and geometric failure causes.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: Main Figure 4 and Tables 3–5 are extended by Appendix Figure 6/7 and Tables 7–9; A.2 turns the reconstruction branch into camera pose, depth and point-cloud evidence. A.3 has no visual object.
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: PDF caption/table baseline is Nimbus Roman No9 L plus Computer Modern math, but embedded visual assets expose Calibri/Segoe/CambriaMath and Figure 5 exposes Helvetica/DejaVuSans; sizes shrink substantially inside dense diagrams and tables.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Light blue/green/orange module roles recur in Figures 2/3/6, while red/green/blue boxes recur in Figures 1/4/6/7. Figure 7 defines box colors locally, but Figure 4/6 do not; Figure 5 uses an independent four-color curve palette and tables are monochrome.

most_reusable_patterns: Figure 1’s video→3D scene→multi-task cards make a single headline interface concrete, then Figures 2/3 expose shared adapter, branches and training boundary.
Table 5 puts reconstruction quality, three VL task metrics and seconds/scene on one decision surface; Table 6 keeps module ablations on the same task surface.
Figures 4/6 use paired qualitative grids, while Figure 7 writes failure as input coverage/surface/viewpoint→geometry defect→task consequence.
Appendix Tables 7–9 decompose the reconstruction branch into pose, depth and point cloud without changing the Method/metric table grammar.
highest_value_objects: Figure 2 — complete method interface and geometry–semantic mechanism.
Table 6 plus Figure 5 — CTA/MD and training convergence evidence.
Figure 7 — explicit geometric failure mechanisms and a retained-success boundary.
failure_patterns: Mixed raster assets and fonts have no public generator parameters; Figure 5 and Figure 7 have no matching source files.
Figure 4/6 red-green-blue box semantics lack a stable legend, and Figure 5 relies mainly on color.
Figure 5 reports a single loss trajectory without repeat or uncertainty information; tables likewise report point estimates only.
Figure 6’s caption is too short to stand alone; Tables 1–4 and 7–9 inconsistently define abbreviations, missing values and input conditions.
Qualitative examples are representative cases and do not establish an overall success or failure rate.
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: The paper uses a shared video-to-3D/VL architecture as its visual spine, explains the causal interface with cross-column mechanism and training diagrams, validates tasks/cost with grouped tables and ablations, and closes with paired qualitative grids plus reconstruction/failure-boundary appendix evidence.
